metadata.title: [FIX][A2A]: Fix response serialization to produce valid JSON instead of Python repr
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
> **Note:** This PR was re-created from #3025 due to repository maintenance. Your code and branch are intact. @madhav165 please verify everything looks good.

# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

Closes #2672

---

## 📌 Summary
Fixes response serialization across the gateway where `str()` was used instead of `orjson.dumps()` to convert Python dicts into `TextContent.text` fields. This produced Python repr output (`{'key': False}` with single quotes and Python booleans) instead of valid JSON (`{"key": false}`), causing downstream consumers to fail when parsing the text content.

## 🐞 Root Cause
When the gateway receives a JSON response (from A2A agents or forwarded MCP responses), the result is a Python dict. Multiple code paths wrapped this dict into `TextContent(type="text", text=str(response_data))`. Python's `str()` on a dict produces repr-style output with single quotes and `True`/`False` literals, which is not valid JSON.

This explains the DEV vs UAT trace discrepancy in the issue:
- **DEV** (valid): `"text": "{\"has_chart\": false, ...}"` — proper JSON
- **UAT** (broken): `"text": "{'has_chart': False, ...}"` — Python repr

## 💡 Fix Description
- **`mcpgateway/services/tool_service.py`**: Replace `str()` with `orjson.dumps().decode()` for dict/list values in A2A response wrapping paths (lines ~3810, ~4765) and REST error response handling (line ~3205). String values are passed through as-is to avoid double-encoding.
- **`mcpgateway/transports/streamablehttp_transport.py`**: Apply the same fix in `_rehydrate_content_items` for unknown content types and validation error fallbacks (line ~800), unknown content type serialization in `call_tool` (line ~914), and A2A response handling in `connect_to_streamablehttp_server` (lines ~3810, ~3842).

commits.message:
fix(a2a): serialize response dicts as valid JSON instead of Python repr

Replace str() with orjson.dumps().decode() when converting Python dicts
into TextContent.text fields across A2A response handling, REST error
paths, and streamable HTTP transport content rehydration.

str() on a dict produces Python repr output ({'key': False} with single
quotes and Python booleans), which is not valid JSON and causes
downstream consumers to fail when parsing the text content.

String values are passed through as-is to avoid double-encoding.

Closes #2672

Signed-off-by: Madhav Kandukuri <madhav165@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Madhav Kandukuri

commits.message:
fix(a2a): add defensive fallback for unserializable plugin post-invoke results

Wrap orjson.dumps() in try/except at the plugin post-invoke path so
that unserializable types (sets, custom objects) returned by plugins
fall back to str() instead of crashing the entire tool invocation with
ToolInvocationError.

Aligns with the existing defensive pattern at tool_service.py:1142-1145.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
test(a2a): add edge-case tests for scalar/null/list serialization paths

Cover the remaining serialization paths with targeted tests:
- _invoke_a2a_tool: None, numeric, list response values and list root
- invoke_tool A2A path: None, list response values and list root
- Plugin post-invoke: unserializable payload fallback to str()

Ensures 100% differential test coverage for all changed lines.
